headline: Multi-source price consensus and five batches of live reserve adapters land alongside two audit remediation campaigns.
fieldNotes: Pricing and reserves both moved toward cross-checked sources. The new N-source consensus module validates prices against Pyth, RedStone, Binance, Coinbase, Curve pools, and real-time FX, while five batches of live reserve adapters began reading reserve data directly for issuers including Tether, Circle, Aave, and Sky. Two audit remediation campaigns ran alongside, adding Zod validation at system boundaries and consolidating shared contracts.

summary.label: Multi-source pricing
summary.description: N-source consensus module integrating Pyth, RedStone, Binance, Coinbase, Curve on-chain prices, and real-time FX rates

summary.label: Live reserve expansion
summary.description: Five batches of reserve adapters (USDT, OUSD, Circle, GHO, Sky, Mento, crvUSD), live collateral scoring in report cards, and drift alerting

summary.label: Deeper digest intelligence
summary.description: Weekly recap format, yield anomaly signals, DEX liquidity shifts, PSI trajectories, and Telegram pending queue for reliable delivery

summary.label: Broader stablecoin coverage
summary.description: dUSD, sdUSD, CETES, Parallel USDp added to tracking; CNHT, EURA, USDA moved to cemetery

summary.label: Codebase hardening
summary.description: Two major audit remediation campaigns (38 tasks), Zod validation at system boundaries, timing-safe auth, and shared contract consolidation

summary.label: Liquidity Score v4
summary.description: Log-scale volume, reworked durability formula, DexScreener and CG ticker fallback crawlers for broader pool coverage

summary.label: Start Here onboarding
summary.description: New onboarding page, compare flow signals, stablecoin coverage matrix, and Telegram global alert subscriptions

summary.label: Yield and flows graduate
summary.description: Yield Intelligence and Mint/Burn Flows promoted from Experimental to Mature, with detail-page yield sections, PYS tooltips, and flash-loan roundtrip filtering
